title: lukasliehr/GrothendieckBessel
summary: A Lean 4 formalization of the existence assertion in Theorem 1.1 of arXiv:2608.12280v1 with the sharp constant K = 1: for every countable Bessel sequence with bound 1 in a complex Hilbert space, there exist measurable functions on the unit interval, pointwise bounded by 1, whose correlations reproduce the sequence's Gram matrix. This solves an open problem posed by Olevskii.

review.reason: Lean formalization of an existence result for Bessel sequences with sharp constant, answering an open problem.
